k-sym-SOCKS.title: Socks Neobank $SOCKS card coins
k-sym-SOCKS.sourceSays: Posts say the Socks account announced a Solana neobank with Apple/Google/Samsung Pay and no KYC; a review bot says card issuance is unconfirmed and the 'first neobank' claim is unsupported.
k-sym-SOCKS.reason: Nov 15 posts describe a product launch by the project account, the same morning the pools opened; the claims are unverified and a review bot flags unconfirmed card issuance.
